usageNotes: Use this endpoint to discover the resource types available under the /cluster/bulk-action namespace; it returns a list of child resource names that can be used to construct further bulk-action requests. No parameters are required and no special privileges are needed beyond a valid API token. This is a discovery/index call — follow the 'name' values in the response to navigate to the actual bulk-action sub-resources.
tips: The response 'name' field in each returned object corresponds to the {name} href link relation — use those values to build sub-resource paths under /cluster/bulk-action/{name}.
This endpoint accepts API tokens (allowtoken: true) so a scoped read-only token is sufficient; no root or admin session required.
Because no filters or parameters are accepted, the response is always the full static list of registered bulk-action resource types for the cluster.
